content.label: wispr flow is very amazing. you should use it and download it. all you need to have is either an apple or google login to use it. it works on every app, like every app you can imagine, unless it doesn't need typing or something like that. i'm actually using wispr flow to send this review it's really amazing and i hope y'all love it. bye. oh and my review is 5 stars because this was the most efficient thing ever. i've had one before. it was horrible but now wispr flow is the best thing that could have ever happened. they also have these modes that you can use to have a very casual, casual, formal, and excited mode. formal is basically everything like a teacher, how a teacher would write. casual is like no caps but punctuation. very casual is no caps and no punctuation. excited is all caps and punctuation. i use very casual
